# spendtron

> spendtron prices GitHub Actions jobs at current per-runner rates. Paste a detailed usage CSV for a chart with no account. Connect the GitHub App for a live sample and a pull request. The chart and the pull requests are free.

## Connect

- MCP endpoint (streamable HTTP): https://spendtron.com/mcp
- Auth: `Authorization: Bearer <API key>`. The key is shown once after installing the GitHub App at https://spendtron.com/github/install
- Claude Code: `claude mcp add --transport http spendtron https://spendtron.com/mcp --header "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY"`

## Tool

- `check_actions_cost`: no arguments. Returns the saved report: workflows priced per job at current runner rates, plus corroborated changes. It does not scan GitHub. Open `/report` once to build the sample.

## Access and pricing

- Upload a detailed usage CSV at `/audit`. It is not stored.
- GitHub App: Actions read, Metadata read, Contents and Pull requests read and write. Write is used only when you submit the pull-request button. A shared report link cannot open pull requests.
- The chart, the sample, and those pull requests are free. A written audit is quoted separately when the figure is about $200 or more.
- In-repo action: `swantron/spendtron/github-action`.

## Links

- Home: https://spendtron.com/
- Audit write-up (812 runs, one workflow was 36% of compute): https://spendtron.com/blog/ci-audit-36-percent
- Install the GitHub App: https://spendtron.com/github/install
- Privacy: https://spendtron.com/privacy
